title: Request-response round trip after handshake
description: Verifies that invoke sends a request with the correct format and resolves when a matching response arrives.
given: A client that has completed the hello/ready handshake
when: invoke('echo', {text: 'hi'}) is called and a response arrives with id 1
then: The request uses the shell's origin (not '*') and the promise resolves with the response result
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::round trips a request once past the handshake
